import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Standardize island labels (trim spaces, fix case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert body mass from text to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Discard body masses outside the valid range
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    # Fix negative flipper lengths
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    # Keep only known sexes
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].where(df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))
    # Drop rows that are now invalid for the requested average
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g']).reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned = clean(df)
    means = cleaned.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2)
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
